Gate suite: PASS
- `git diff --check main...HEAD` exits 0. HEAD is main here, so this range is empty. I also ran `git diff --check 3e4705a HEAD`, which covers the parent's whole change, and it exits 0 too.
- `uv run --frozen pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/factory` exits 0 with `647 passed in 116.76s`.

Probes (I ran them on main through the wrapper, each against a fresh store):
- `stats --scorecard` on a store with one ticket and no events → exit 0. The table shows zeros and dashes, and the heading reads `<store path>: target changes (no instance found)`, which is the form the spec allows when no instance is found → OK
- `--since 2026-13-01` → exit 2 with `--since '2026-13-01' is not an ISO date or date-time` → OK
- `--until 2026-10-01` before `--since 2026-10-10` → exit 0, and the windows print inverted (`2026-10-19 to 2026-10-10, and 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-01`) → CONCERN, minor. No criterion covers this input, so it is not a FAIL.
- `escape add --issue '   '` (spaces only) → exit 2 with `--issue is empty`. `--note 'HTTPS://a.b'` → exit 2. A note with a link but no scheme (`a.example/x`) is accepted and stored as written. The spec's rule tests only for `://`, so this follows the spec → OK
- `intervention add` with `--kind ''` → exit 2. With no `--ticket` → exit 0, and the event carries no ticket. With an unknown sub-ticket id → exit 2 → OK
- `run finish --transcripts` with a directory that does not exist → exit 0, and no `claude:` record is written. This matches "a run whose transcript cannot be found records no cost, as today" → OK
- `run finish` with one malformed JSON line inside a transcript → the valid lines are still counted (3/4/5/6) and the finish exits 0. With an empty `--reply` file → the transcript record is used → OK
- Two transcripts that both name the run and both start after it → `run finish` silently takes the first one (`a.jsonl`) and drops the other's tokens. The requirement says "the one transcript", so the spec does not define this case → CONCERN, minor. It is outside the stated criteria.

Out-of-scope observations: none beyond the two minor concerns above. Neither is a FAIL; I list them for the operator to decide on.

STATUS: VERIFIED
CONFIDENCE: high. All 22 scenarios ran as written on main and matched their THEN lines, with the 25-line table matched by exact diff. Every NEW scenario failed on base exactly as the spec predicts. The full suite passes, and the probes found no special-casing.
